hero.eyebrow: School of Dental Science · Trinity College Dublin
hero.title: How pathogens cause disease and resist treatment
hero.intro: We are a microbiology research group at the Dublin Dental University Hospital. We study the fungal pathogen Candida albicans, the bacteria of the oral microbiome and antibiotic-resistant hospital pathogens: how they cause infection, what drives their virulence, and how they resist antimicrobial drugs.
hero.origin: Our name comes from Candida dubliniensis, the yeast species first described in this laboratory in 1995.

themes.title: The TLO gene family and Mediator
themes.text: How an expanded family of Mediator subunit genes shapes metabolism, stress responses, filamentation and virulence in C. albicans.

themes.title: Oral microbes and disease
themes.text: How oral microorganisms such as Candida albicans and Fusobacterium nucleatum cause disease, studied with genetics, genomics and metagenomics.

themes.title: Staphylococcal genomics and resistance
themes.text: Whole-genome sequencing to track multidrug-resistant MRSA and the mobile genetic elements that spread resistance.
